## Personality

Maria is characterized by a tendency to always laugh in conversation. Following her travels, she has also become noticeably restless and discontented.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006), [v3 ch.Dawn P3](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0003)_

## History

Maria is an acquaintance mentioned in Phil's letter to [Anne](../character/anne.md) regarding the summer spent at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She is among the quirky guests staying at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) spent her summer.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003), [v3 ch.Relationships P7](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P9](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0009), [v3 ch.Relationships P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), [v3 ch.Relationships P16](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0016), +30 more_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Maria and [Patty](../character/patty.md) are comradely traveling companions who share a bond while residing abroad together. Their relationship is grounded in their shared living arrangements, as seen when Maria lives alongside [Patty](../character/patty.md) and their mutual friends at Patty's Place. Over time, their dynamic settles into a cozy household routine marked by the lively atmosphere of their communal home.

- Comrade of — traveling companions abroad  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007)</sub>
